zh-CN: FloraDoc Word Preview Windows x64 试用版，提供单文件 Markdown 创建 DOCX、DOCX 模板填充以及已验证的 Style/Template 查询与选择。
包含 Windows x64 安装器和便携 ZIP；安装器可选择当前用户或所有用户安装。
floradoc update 使用官网 HTTPS 清单检查更新，并在下载后校验 SHA-256。
en: FloraDoc Word Preview trial for Windows x64 supports single-file Markdown to DOCX, DOCX template filling, and verified Style/Template discovery and selection.
Includes a Windows x64 installer and portable ZIP. The installer supports per-user or all-users installation.
floradoc update checks the official HTTPS feed and verifies the installer SHA-256 after download.

zh-CN: Windows 10 或更新版本，x64；无需安装 .NET SDK、Python 或 Microsoft Word。
en: Windows 10 or later, x64; no .NET SDK, Python, or Microsoft Word installation is required.

zh-CN: 普通用户运行 FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe，按需选择当前用户或所有用户安装；安装后重新打开终端并运行 floradoc --version。
便携 ZIP 解压到固定目录后运行其中的 floradoc.exe；便携包不配置 PATH，且不支持安装器驱动的更新和卸载。
en: Run FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe and choose per-user or all-users installation. Reopen the terminal and run floradoc --version.
Extract the portable ZIP to a fixed folder and run its floradoc.exe. The portable package does not configure PATH or support installer-driven updates and uninstall.
